subject: Subprocessor addition (EU) — order form impact, DPA/redline next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmecorp.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.company
Cc: tom.ellis@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: proposed subprocessor addition (LogStream) — order form + DPA impact

Hi Aditya,

Following our internal security review, we need to notify you that Acme is onboarding an analytics subprocessor (LogStream Ltd) that would process logs for the usage metrics bucket for any EU-resident data. Our legal team flagged the need to align the Order Form and the DPA (Annex A) with the additional subprocessor.

Quick summary: 
- Subprocessor: LogStream Ltd (Ireland) — syslog aggregation & retention 30 days
- Scope: access to aggregated telemetry, no customer PII
- Proposed start: 2029-09-01

Attached is a draft subprocessor addendum we use internally (ACME_Subprocessor_Addendum_v1_redline.docx). Can you confirm Redwood's procurement/legal routing and whether an Order Form amendment or a standalone addendum is preferred? Also, any impact to pricing or SLA we should expect?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call today.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Procurement Lead | Acme Corporation
Attachments: ACME_Subprocessor_Addendum_v1_redline.docx

---
From: aditya_rao@redwood.company
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmecorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.company, laura_bennett@redwood.company
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: proposed subprocessor addition (LogStream) — order form + DPA impact

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the redline. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Laura (Revenue ops) to triage.

Immediate answers:
- We typically accept a standalone subprocessor addendum for housekeeping, but if the change creates a material change to data residency or obligations we route an Order Form amendment.
- Pricing: if LogStream introduces additional storage/egress costs for Redwood (unlikely at the telemetry level), Laura will flag. For now we expect no pricing delta.
- SLA: no change expected unless customer-facing logs are retained longer — again unlikely.

Kimberly / Laura — can you review the attached redline and call out: (1) any EU-specific DPA language we must add (e.g., SCCs / reference to EEA subprocessors), (2) whether we need an Order Form amendment, and (3) a proposed sign-off timeline so Acme can schedule their rollout.

Aditya
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.company
To: aditya_rao@redwood.company, laura_bennett@redwood.company
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmecorp.com>, tom.ellis@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Aug 2029 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: proposed subprocessor addition (LogStream) — order form + DPA impact

Thanks Sophie / Aditya — I reviewed the draft addendum. High-level notes for the thread: 

1) DPA alignment (EU-focused) — required edits
- Add specific SCC reference block and insert clause requiring subprocessors to be subject to the same data protection obligations as Redwood.
- Clarify data access controls (role-based access + audit logging) for LogStream.

2) Order Form vs standalone addendum
- This looks like a low-risk telemetry subprocessor; we can accept a standalone addendum for execution. However, Acme must confirm: 
  * No retention beyond 30 days for EU logs; 
  * No cross-border transfer outside EEA without written notice.
If either is false we escalate to an Order Form amendment.

3) Operational asks (Revenue/Ops) — Laura: please confirm no price uplift and capture a short note for the order form metadata if we proceed. 

4) Sign-off timeline & DocuSign plan
- Legal redline will be returned within 48 business hours assuming no new material changes.
- If accepted, we will prepare a DocuSign envelope and propose execution by 2029-08-22 to meet Acme's rollout.

I attached a marked-up excerpt (I pasted the small redline below for visibility).

> [redline snippet] Section 2(b): "Subprocessor shall implement administrative and technical measures equivalent to those required by Redwood..." -> add: "and provide audit evidence upon reasonable request"

Advised next steps for Sophie: confirm the two operational confirmations (retention and cross-border transfer) and we will issue a clean addendum + DocuSign link.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm-ACME-2029-08.pdf

---
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmecorp.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.company
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acmecorp.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.company, laura_bennett@redwood.company
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: proposed subprocessor addition (LogStream) — order form + DPA impact

Hi all — quick answers from our side: 
- Confirmed: LogStream will retain aggregated EU logs for 30 days only.
- Confirmed: No intentional cross-border export of EU-resident logs (LogStream based in IE, processing in EEA).

Thanks for the quick review, Kimberly. Sophie and I are good with the standalone addendum + DocuSign flow. Please send the DocuSign link when ready and we'll get it executed by 2029-08-22 (we have an internal change freeze then).

Tom Ellis
Director of Security Engineering | Acme Corporation
